text: Material processing engineering is an important branch of materials science and engineering, focusing on the shaping, modification, preparation, and performance optimization of materials. By studying the physical, chemical, and mechanical changes of materials during the processing, it develops efficient, green, and precise processing technologies, ultimately achieving the transformation of materials from "raw materials" to "high-performance products". This discipline serves as a crucial link connecting materials research and industrial application, and is widely applied in core fields of the national economy such as manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, energy, and electronics.
